resources.string: Find more modules on Mochy’s Bar <3
Modules are made by other people, so reports about a 3rd party module will be ignored. Want to make your own?
Swipe to delete, drag the lines to reorder
Its settings and anything you added to it go with it. You can add it again any time.
A module is a service someone else runs. Mochy only asks it for songs, lyrics or a look, and it can\'t touch anything else in the app.
That doesn\'t look like a link. It should start with https://
Couldn\'t reach that link. Check it and your connection, then try again.
That link answered, but it isn\'t a module Mochy can use.
That\'s a website, not a module. If it\'s a Monochrome site, add it on Monochrome\'s page under Servers instead.
A module someone sent you as a .zip. A look works straight from the file, and so does one that brings its own code. Others that play songs or lyrics need their service online.
That file isn\'t a module. A module\'s .zip has a manifest.json inside it.
This module plays songs or lyrics, but its .zip doesn\'t say where from. Its manifest.json needs a \"url\" pointing at its service.
Couldn\'t load the catalog. Check your connection and open this again.
Nothing in the catalog yet. Paste a module\'s link above to add it.
It starts switched off, so nothing changes until you turn it on from its page.
You already have this one. Adding it again updates it to what the link says now.
Signed in to %1$s. It\'s on now.
Turn the module on to open its pages.
This page isn\'t here anymore. Turn its module back on, or add the module again.
dont report to us when not working, report to the server owner. PLEASE FTSOG
Paste a Monochrome site, or its server\'s own link. Mochy checks that it can search there before adding it.
Couldn\'t find a Monochrome server there. Try the site\'s main page, or the server\'s own link.
That server is already on the list.
Sign in first, then turn it on here.
Songs play from %1$s when it has them, in the order set under Audio Quality.
Its lyrics join your lyrics sources.
Its look replaces your look settings while it\'s on, and yours come back when you turn it off.
What it knows about a song shows first in About song.
Its player shader didn\'t load, so the player shows its fallback: %1$s
Its player shaders need Android 13, so this phone shows their fallbacks.
Its glass didn\'t load, so the bars keep Mochy\'s frost: %1$s
Its glass needs Android 13 or newer, so this phone keeps Mochy\'s frost.
While data saver is working, songs from this module play at %1$s to use less data.
This module has no lighter stream, so it plays as usual. Turn it off while you\'re on mobile data to save more.
Also in Settings while it\'s on
Pick a song and see every step this module takes with it, on this phone. Tap a song to start.
Everything works. With %1$s on, play anything and a toast says where each song comes from.
Not available: lossless, Dolby Atmos and Apple\'s Spatial mix (Apple only encodes those for its own DRM, FairPlay) and downloads (web players get no offline licenses).
CD-quality FLAC when the service has it.
24-bit FLAC when there\'s one. If this phone can\'t decode it, the CD-quality one plays.
Around 320 kbps, a lot less data.
The usual mix, lossless when the service has it.
The Dolby Atmos mix when the service has one. It isn\'t lossless, and a phone that can\'t decode it gets stereo.

Tap YouTube Music to turn it on or off, or a module to open its page. Drag a handle to change the order: each song plays from the first one that\'s on and has it. Modules you\'ve switched off aren\'t listed here.
How songs downloaded from YouTube are saved, from now on. Downloads already made stay as they are.

Each download comes from the first provider here that has the song as one whole file. Streams that come in pieces, or that need a license, are skipped. YouTube is always here for downloads, even when it\'s off for playing.
Add from a file or a link
Pick a .zip, or paste a link to a zip or a single file. %1$s keeps whatever it can use from it.
%1$s works from a link, so it was added as its own module. Turn it on from its page under Modules.
That file isn\'t a zip. Pick a .zip, or paste a link instead.
There\'s nothing in there %1$s can use.
What\'s in there is broken, so it can\'t run. Ask whoever made it for a fixed copy.
That\'s too big for %1$s to take.
This module runs its own code, so it has to be signed with the same key as your Mochy, and this copy isn\'t. Get the one made for your build of Mochy.
This module\'s code didn\'t start. It may be made for a different version of Mochy.
That GitHub project hasn\'t published a release yet. Ask whoever made it to publish one with the module\'s .zip attached.
The newest release has no module in it. Mochy looks for a .zip with \"mochyymodule\" in its name, like glass.mochyymodule.zip.
These change how %1$s looks. They\'re the same settings as on the module\'s page.
Turn the module on to change these.
Something new was published for it.
You\'re on the newest one. Checked %1$s.
Mochy looks for a newer one a few times a day.
